text.aria-label: Title text 'At the eight MVA Primaries the lag gap is as large at night as in sunny half-hours Mean CRPS gap at 24-120 h; above zero means the lag arm is better. Sunny: forecast shortwave at least 0.6 of clear sky, with the sun above 5 degrees. Hours with fewer than 300 half-hours of a type are left out.'
text.tspan: At the eight MVA Primaries the lag gap is as large at night as in sunny half-hours
Mean CRPS gap at 24-120 h; above zero means the lag arm is better.
Sunny: forecast shortwave at least 0.6 of clear sky, with the sun above 5 degrees.
Hours with fewer than 300 half-hours of a type are left out.
